title: Lemon Orzo with Feta and Herbs
description: Bright, lemony orzo tossed with crumbled feta, fresh dill and mint, olives, and toasted pine nuts. Works warm, room temp, or straight from the fridge the next day.

steps.text: Cook orzo in well-salted boiling water until al dente, usually 8 to 9 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
While still hot, toss the orzo with olive oil, lemon zest, and lemon juice. The heat helps the orzo absorb all that flavor.
Add cucumber, olives, dill, and mint. Toss to combine. If the orzo looks dry or clumpy, splash in a bit of the reserved pasta water.
Fold in most of the feta, saving a handful for the top.
Season with salt and pepper — go easy on the salt since feta and olives bring plenty. Top with the remaining feta and toasted pine nuts.

_pipeline.originalInspiration: Bon Appetit's Lemony Orzo Pasta Salad
